encyclopedia.summary: Haro Aso serialised this manga from 2010 to 2015 under the title Imawa no Kuni no Arisu. Survivors in a hollowed-out Tokyo have to clear games whose difficulty and type are set by playing cards. The rules and the players' nerves come apart together, and after it ended the story was adapted for television drama and anime.
highlights: Card suits set each game's difficulty and kind.
Whether the survivors can trust each other is the real rule of every game.
The emptied Tokyo puts pressure on every choice the cast makes.

encyclopedia.summary: Hiroya Oku's manga ran in Evening from 2014 to 2017. A middle-aged man ignored by his own family is turned into a machine body in a park one night, and a boy who was in the same accident uses that power to kill. One saves people and the other kills them, and the contrast is the question the story asks about power.
highlights: An ordinary middle-aged lead makes the story of power read differently.
Two people from the same accident take opposite directions.
Oku returns to the violence and salvation he handled in Gantz.

related.note: The same author's earlier work on violence and salvation
